ticks.note: Equations run in every tick, the first one included. Everything is shut, so `ready` is true; the alarm is not armed, so `siren` is false.
The door opens. `ready` drops to false in this same tick. `siren` stays false: the alarm is still not armed.
Arming with the door open: `armed && (door || window)` is true, so `siren` is true at once. There is no state to move to and no delay.
The door shuts and both outputs follow immediately: `siren` false, `ready` true.
A window opens while armed: `siren` true, `ready` false, again in the tick the input changed.
